target.title: fix(compaction): avoid cached usage overcount
target.body:
Closes #99843

AI-assisted: Codex.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long cached agent turns could auto-compact far below the configured reserve threshold when the context estimator received a turn-aggregated usage object with `totalTokens` missing or zero. In that state, repeated `cacheRead` buckets from multiple provider calls were summed as if they were one context-window snapshot, so sessions could compact early and report a misleadingly huge token count.

## Why This Change Was Made

The estimator now keeps positive provider `totalTokens` as the trusted context snapshot, preserves cache buckets for plausible single-call cached snapshots, and uses the model `contextWindow` at compaction/session call sites to reject impossible cache-bucket fallbacks that exceed the live model window. Embedded-run metadata coverage also proves billing usage can remain accumulated while context/session snapshots come from the latest real call.

## User Impact

Users running long cached tool-loop sessions should no longer see safeguard compaction fire early just because cached prompt tokens were counted repeatedly across calls. Trusted cached snapshots still count cached prompt context, so sessions do not delay compaction merely because a provider omitted `totalTokens`.

## Evidence

- Current PR head: `4bc55b69f14ea3929058c769d7841e3fd1c6d75e`.
- AgentSession threshold/display probe: `node --import tsx -e ...AgentSession.prototype.checkCompaction...` -> `aggregateResult:false`, `aggregateUsage.tokens:15116`, `snapshotUsage.tokens:163978` for a 300,000 context window and 120,000 reserve. This proves the real session threshold path avoids #99843 aggregate overcount while preserving a trusted cached missing-total snapshot.
- Core estimator + agent-meta probe: `node --import tsx -e ...calculateContextTokens...buildUsageAgentMetaFields...` -> `snapshot:163978`, `aggregate:15116`, `compact:false`, `metaTotal:163978`, `promptTokens:148874`.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/agent-harness.ts src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/helpers.test.ts` -> passed.
- `git diff --check -- packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/agent-harness.ts src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/helpers.test.ts` -> passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run ...` and `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ...` did not reach test output locally after repeated Windows runner hangs in the build layer; the current SHA's GitHub checks are running for full CI proof.
- `autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` was attempted after revision, but the Codex review backend returned a usage-limit error before producing review JSON.
